column_configs.reasoning: A reshape should keep values exactly. RAE with a 1e-6 tolerance requires each cell to match within float precision, with NaNs in the same rows (two NaNs count as a match). The values are rounded to 2 decimal places, so a tight tolerance is appropriate.

comparison_plan.overall_reasoning: This is a wide-to-long reshape, so the expression values should carry over exactly. 'expression' is the only data column; sample and gene are ID columns used for alignment. I used RAE with a tight tolerance of 1e-6, so each cell has to match within floating-point precision. Pearson would be too loose for a reshape. Missing values have to be in the same rows, and the comparison counts a NaN in both reference and candidate as a match.
